narr: An upper level trough brought a cold front to the region. Ahead of this cold front, moisture levels through the atmospheric column increased to above the 90th percentile for this time of year. Ample instability in place combine with the abundant moisture and lift from the frontal boundary set the stage for numerous thunderstorms producing heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
ev: Broadcast media reported Rocky Mountain Drive, Olympia Way and Sierra Cove closed due to flooding.
Broadcast media reported via social media Wilkes Avenue closed due to high water.
Broadcast media shared a video of a car stalling in flood water on MS Highway 90 near Courthouse Road.
